style.vernacular: Concrete-frame city: dense six-to-eight storey polykatoikia apartment blocks of the 1950s-70s in cream, ochre and grey painted render with continuous balcony slabs, awnings and rooftop water tanks and solar heaters; scattered neoclassical townhouses in pale stucco with red-tile hip roofs; marble, limestone and white Pentelic stone for civic and ancient sites; Byzantine churches of stone framed by red brick under tiled domes; modern glass-and-steel public buildings and malls. Flat concrete roofs dominate, red clay tile on older and suburban houses. Pine, olive, plane and orange trees under bright light.
style.ornament: Continuous balcony bands with metal railings and striped awnings on polykatoikia; neoclassical pediments, acroteria, pilasters and tall shuttered windows on older townhouses; cloisonne masonry (stone blocks framed by red brick) and brick arch frames on Byzantine churches; marble steps, columns and Doric porticoes at ancient and civic sites; rooftop water tanks and solar heaters.

sources.what: limestone and white marble as the local building stones; fired clay roof tiles; neoclassical and Greek Revival adaptation of ancient forms
cloisonne masonry of light stone blocks framed by red brick, brick arch window frames, orange tile roof, central dome
marble and granite paving, deciduous shade trees, busts, Mediterranean planting in a central Athens park
